h.gu: 6.1.1 Pump નો હેતુ અને Energy Transfer

body.en:
A pump transfers mechanical energy to a liquid, enabling flow against a required system resistance/elevation. Pressure, velocity and elevation contributions are described using head. A pump does not manufacture liquid or create energy.

Examples are water supply, irrigation, circulation and process-fluid service. Selection needs flow rate, head, liquid properties, available inlet conditions and compatible materials. A large motor alone does not guarantee a suitable pump.
body.gu:
Pump liquid ને mechanical energy આપે, જેથી required elevation/resistance સામે flow થાય. Pressure, velocity અને elevation ને head વડે સમજીએ. Pump liquid અથવા energy બનાવતો નથી.

Water supply, irrigation, circulation/process service માટે. Flow/head, liquid properties, inlet conditions અને materials પરથી selection થાય; મોટો motor જ પૂરતો નથી.

body.en:
Positive-displacement pumps trap/displace a volume per operating cycle; reciprocating piston/plunger and selected rotary pumps are examples. Rotodynamic pumps use a rotating impeller to transfer energy continuously; centrifugal pumps are a common example.

Compare operation, flow character, speed/head range and liquid compatibility. Never assume a positive-displacement pump can safely discharge into a closed outlet; overpressure protection and authorised procedures are essential.
body.gu:
Positive-displacement pump cycle દીઠ volume trap/displace કરે; reciprocating piston/plunger અને rotary ઉદાહરણો. Rotodynamic માં rotating impeller continuously energy આપે; centrifugal common છે.

Flow character, speed/head અને liquid compatibility compare કરો. Positive-displacement outlet બંધ રાખીને ચાલશે એવું ન માનો; overpressure protection જરૂરી છે.

body.en:
A cylinder contains a reciprocating piston/plunger driven through a rod/crank arrangement. Suction and delivery passages have non-return valves; suction pipe connects the supply and delivery pipe leads to the load. A strainer/foot valve or air vessel may be included in suitable designs.

Single-acting means pumping occurs on one working side of the piston; double-acting designs use both sides with appropriate valve arrangements. An air vessel is not the same part as the cylinder.
body.gu:
Cylinder માં piston/plunger rod/crank થી reciprocate થાય. Suction/delivery passages માં non-return valves; suction supply ને અને delivery load ને જોડે. Design મુજબ strainer/foot valve અથવા air vessel હોઈ શકે.

Single-acting માં piston ની એક working side pump કરે; double-acting બંને side વાપરે. Air vessel cylinder જ નથી.

body.en:
As the piston moves to increase the working chamber volume, its pressure decreases relative to the supply. The suction valve opens when the pressure difference permits flow, while delivery remains closed. Liquid enters due to the available pressure difference.

The pump does not “pull” water from an unlimited depth. Atmospheric/supply pressure, liquid vapour pressure, losses and elevation limit available suction conditions.
body.gu:
Piston chamber volume વધારે ત્યારે pressure supply કરતાં ઘટે. યોગ્ય pressure difference થી suction valve ખૂલે, delivery બંધ રહે અને liquid અંદર આવે.

Unlimited depth માંથી water pull થતું નથી. Atmospheric/supply p, vapour p, losses અને elevation inlet limits નક્કી કરે.

body.en:
The return motion reduces chamber volume and raises pressure. Suction valve closes; delivery valve opens when chamber pressure exceeds the delivery-side requirement. Liquid is displaced into delivery pipe.

The basic single-cylinder output is pulsating rather than perfectly uniform. Appropriate air vessels/multiple cylinders can smooth it in engineered systems. Valve leakage, seal wear and air entry affect performance; no actual test is claimed.
body.gu:
Return motion chamber volume ઘટાડે અને p વધારે. Suction valve બંધ, chamber p delivery requirement કરતાં વધે ત્યારે delivery valve ખૂલે અને liquid બહાર જાય.

Basic single-cylinder flow pulsating છે. Engineered air vessel/multiple cylinders smooth કરી શકે. Leakage, wear અને air entry થી performance બદલાય; actual test નો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
Main components include the impeller with an eye/inlet and curved passages, casing (volute/diffuser arrangement), shaft, bearings, sealing system, suction and delivery connections. A driver rotates the shaft.

The impeller transfers energy; the casing/diffuser collects flow and converts part of velocity energy to pressure under its design. A mechanical seal is not a normal flow-control valve.
body.gu:
Impeller eye/inlet અને passages, volute/diffuser casing, shaft/bearings, sealing system અને suction/delivery connections મુખ્ય parts. Driver shaft ફેરવે છે.

Impeller energy આપે; casing/diffuser flow collect અને થોડું velocity energy pressure માં ફેરવે. Mechanical seal flow-control valve નથી.

body.en:
Liquid enters near the impeller eye. The rotating blades do work on the liquid, guiding it outward with increased energy. It enters the casing/diffuser and leaves through the delivery connection; lower pressure near the eye supports continued inflow when inlet conditions are adequate.

Not all of the pressure rise occurs only in the casing; the impeller also contributes. Flow/head depend on speed, impeller and system resistance. Running without adequate liquid can damage seals and other components.
body.gu:
Liquid eye પાસે આવે. Rotating blades liquid પર work કરીને outward energy વધારે. Casing/diffuser માંથી delivery તરફ જાય; eye પાસે lower p અને યોગ્ય inlet condition થી inflow ચાલુ રહે.

Pressure rise ફક્ત casing માં જ થાય એવું નહીં; impeller પણ ફાળો આપે. Flow/head speed, impeller અને system પર આધારિત. Liquid વગર ચલાવવાથી seal/components બગડે.

body.en:
Priming is preparing an appropriate pump by filling the required casing/suction path with liquid and removing trapped air as specified. A conventional non-self-priming centrifugal pump cannot normally establish the intended liquid flow when its passages contain only air.

A foot valve may retain prime where designed. Self-priming pumps use special arrangements and still require their specified preparation. Priming is not universally needed in an identical way for every pump, and boiler priming means a different carryover phenomenon.
body.gu:
Priming એટલે specified casing/suction path liquid થી ભરવો અને trapped air દૂર કરવાની તૈયારી. Conventional non-self-priming centrifugal pump માં ફક્ત air હોય તો intended liquid flow સામાન્ય રીતે સ્થાપિત ન થાય.

Foot valve prime retain કરી શકે. Self-priming design માં પણ specified preparation જોઈએ. દરેક pump માં same priming નહીં; boiler priming નો અર્થ carryover જુદો છે.

body.en:
Reciprocating pumps are positive-displacement, commonly lower-speed/pulsating and suitable for selected higher-head duties. Centrifugal pumps are rotodynamic, commonly smoother-flow and suitable for a broad range of water/circulation duties. Actual ranges overlap and require specifications.

Use supervised unpowered models for dismantling identification. Isolate electrical/mechanical/pressure energy and drain safely under an authorised procedure. Never remove a coupling guard, loosen pressurised fittings or start an unprimed pump as an experiment.
body.gu:
Reciprocating positive-displacement, સામાન્ય lower-speed/pulsating અને selected higher-head માટે. Centrifugal rotodynamic, સામાન્ય smoother flow અને water/circulation duties માટે. Actual ranges overlap થાય.

Dismantling માટે supervised unpowered model. Authorised isolation/depressurisation જરૂરી. Guard દૂર, pressurised fitting loosen અથવા unprimed pump શરૂ કરવાનો experiment નહીં.

a.en: Allow intended inlet flow and oppose reverse flow.
a.gu: Inlet flow આપવો અને reverse નો વિરોધ.

q.en: Does casing alone add all head?

a.en: Specified liquid filling and air-removal preparation.

terms.en: Pump-specific, not a universal identical procedure.
